faqs.question: Why don't you use standard page builders like Elementor, Divi, or Wix?
faqs.answer: Page builders write bloated, inefficient code. They generate excessive CSS, JavaScript, and nested HTML tags. This degrades load speeds, lowers mobile conversion rates, and hurts technical SEO. We write custom, lightweight code. It ensures your site loads instantly and remains highly secure.

faqs.question: What content management systems (CMS) do you support?
faqs.answer: We develop for WordPress, Shopify, and headless platforms like Sanity or Contentful. We decouple the front-end design from the database. This approach gives you the speed of a static site with the ease of a modern editing interface.

faqs.question: Will my site be easy to edit after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure clear, custom fields in the backend. You can edit text, swap images, and publish blog posts without knowing how to code. You cannot break the design layout, keeping your brand consistent.

faqs.question: How do you make websites load so quickly?
faqs.answer: We eliminate redundant JavaScript libraries, optimize asset sizes, utilize modern image formats (AVIF/WebP), implement critical CSS extraction, and deploy through content delivery networks (CDNs). Every kilobyte of code must justify its existence.

faqs.question: Do you design in Figma before coding?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design every page in Figma. We share interactive prototypes with you. You approve the exact visual design and user flow before we write the first line of code.

faqs.question: Can you migrate our existing site's content and design?
faqs.answer: We can. We migrate existing blog posts, product pages, and redirect maps. We retain your SEO authority while rebuilding the interface to be faster and higher-converting.

faqs.question: How do you test for cross-device compatibility?
faqs.answer: We test on real physical hardware and cloud simulation environments. We cover iOS, Android, Safari, Chrome, Firefox, and Edge. The site is optimized to behave perfectly on mobile, tablet, and ultra-wide screens.

faqs.question: Do you offer post-launch support and edits?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer continuous technical maintenance plans. These cover core updates, performance audits, and quick design or copy updates. Detailed pricing is available under our Website Care service.
